verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph documents broad programmatic coverage of core Teams actions: creating teams, adding members, configuring channels, tabs and apps (ms-teams-docs-35/43), sending channel messages (ms-teams-docs-11), automating teams, channels and conversations (ms-teams-docs-8/19), and exporting chats, including deleted messages (ms-teams-docs-13/14). However, nothing in the pack claims or demonstrates that the API covers everything possible in the UI. The Agents Toolkit CLI's parity is with IDE extensions, not the Teams UI, so it does not count here. missing for 10: an explicit API-to-UI parity statement, evidence of API coverage for meetings, calling, settings and notifications, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
